                               CORPORATE PROFILE
                                                 企業簡介

Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Limited (the “Group”; SEHK stock code: 1929) was listed on the Main Board of The Stock
Exchange of Hong Kong in December 2011. The Group’s vision is to become the most trusted jewellery group in the world.


Founded in 1929, the Group’s iconic brand “CHOW TAI FOOK” is widely recognised for its trustworthiness and authenticity,
and is renowned for its product design, quality and value. A long-standing commitment to innovation and craftsmanship has
contributed to the Group’s success, along with that of its iconic retail brand, and has been embodied in its rich 90-year
heritage. Underpinning this success are our long-held core values of “Sincerity • Eternity”.


The Group’s differentiation strategy continues to make inroads into diverse customer segments by catering to a bespoke
experience for different lifestyles and personalities, as well as customers’ different life stages. Offering a wide variety of
products, services and channels, the Group’s brand portfolio comprises the CHOW TAI FOOK flagship brand with curated
retail experiences, and other individual brands including HEARTS ON FIRE, ENZO, SOINLOVE and MONOLOGUE.


The Group’s commitment to sustainable growth is anchored in its customer-centric focus and strategies, which are in place
to promote long-term innovation in business, in people and in culture. Another asset underpinning sustainable growth is a
sophisticated and agile business model. This supports the Group by fostering excellence and extending opportunities along
the entire value chain to communities and industry partners across the world.


With an extensive retail network in Greater China, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia and the United States, and a fast-growing
e-commerce business, the Group is implementing effective online-to-offline (“O2O”) strategies to succeed in today’s omni-
channel retail environment.


周大福珠寶集團有限公司（「集團」；香港聯交所股份代號：1929）於 2011 年 12 月在香港聯合交易所主板上市，以成為全球最值得
信賴的珠寶集團為願景。


集團標誌性品牌「周大福」創立於 1929 年，廣獲認同為信譽及正貨的象徵，並以產品設計、品質與價值聞名。集團及其標誌性品
牌的成功，從過去 90 多年的悠久歷史，體現出對創新和工藝的持久堅持，以及恒久抱持的核心價值「真誠 • 永恒」。


周大福憑藉差異化策略在不同顧客群的市場穩步發展，並提供貼身的消費體驗。透過提供多元化的產品、服務和銷售渠道，滿足
其 不 同 人 生 階 段 的 需 要。 集 團 的 差 異 化 品 牌 策 略 以 周 大 福 旗 艦 品 牌 為 核 心， 並 相 繼 推 出 針 對 性 的 零 售 體 驗， 以 及
HEARTS ON FIRE、ENZO、SOINLOVE 與 MONOLOGUE等其他個性品牌，每個品牌都承載著不同顧客群的生活態度和個性。


集團借助以客為本的重點及其策略為基礎，實踐業務可持續增長的承諾，致力於業務、員工和文化方面推動長遠的創新發展。發
展成熟的靈活業務模式是推動集團可持續增長的一大優勢，在整個價值鏈中支持集團追求卓越，以及延伸商機至不同社區和全球
的行業合作夥伴。


集團擁有龐大的零售網絡，遍及大中華、日本、韓國、東南亞與美國，並經營發展迅速的電子商務業務，能有效地執行線上線下
策略，在現今的全渠道零售環境下成功突圍而出。

SMART MANUFACTURING                                                   智慧製造
The objective of smart manufacturing is to increase the operational   智慧製造的目標是提高整體供應鏈的運作速度。有鑑
speed of the overall supply chain. To this end, we implement the      於此，我們實行顧客主導製造，令生產與顧客以及前
C2M initiative, so that production can seamlessly be connected        線無縫接軌。與此同時，我們集中提升產品開發能力，
with customers and the frontline. Meanwhile, we also focus on         為我們的實動力 — 零售擴張策略提供更好支援。
enhancing product development capability to better support our
retail expansion strategy in the coming years.


C2M                                                                   顧客主導製造
• We adopt the Industry 4.0 framework to transform the                • 我們採用工業 4.0 框架，將傳統的製造模式轉變為
   conventional manufacturing model into C2M of which D-ONE is         顧客主導製造，而 D-ONE 就是顧客主導製造的其中
   one of our implementation measures.                                 一個實踐措施。


• We make full use of the Internet of Things (“IoT”) technology in    • 我們在生產過程中充分借助物聯網技術，讓設備互
   our production processes, such that equipment is interconnected     聯 互 通， 把 人 手 處 理 的 工 作 減 至 最 低。 我 們 藉
   and minimum human involvement is required. We connect our           D-ONE 把高度自動化的生產線與顧客無縫對接，提
   highly automated production lines with customers seamlessly via     供滿足顧客定制產品需求的極速服務。
   D-ONE, providing customers speedy services that can fulfil their
   needs for customised products.


• We also apply the “Digital Twin” model to establish a digital       • 我們並應用「數字孿生」模型，透過生產仿真系統建
   virtual factory through a production simulation system for          立數字化的虛擬工廠，以便進行幾何級數的模擬，
   performing geometric simulations, and in turn identifying the       從而確定最佳的生產安排及資源配置，同時在實體
   optimum production arrangement and resource allocation. At          工廠透過各工序及設備的傳感器，實時掌握生產的
   the same time, we use sensors in each process and equipment         實際進度，與模擬的預估作比對，讓管理人員能即
   in physical factories to control actual production progress         時對異常情況作出處理。
   against simulated estimates in real time, allowing management
   personnel to deal with abnormal situations immediately.

• We principally meet our working capital and other liquidity           • 我們主要透過來自經營現金流量、銀行貸款及黃金
   requirements through a combination of capital contributions,          借貸的資本來源應付營運資金及其他流動資金需
   including cash flows from operations, bank borrowings and gold        求。黃金借貸亦用作經濟避險目的以減輕本集團黃
   loans. Gold loans are also used for economic hedge purpose to         金存貨價格波動的財務影響。
   mitigate the financial impact of the price fluctuations in the
   Group’s gold inventories.


• The Group’s daily operation was mainly financed by operating          • 本集團日常業務所需資金主要來自經營現金流量，
   cash flows, and mainly relied on short-term borrowings to satisfy     亦會主要以短期借貸滿足旺季時的存貨資金需求、
   inventory financing needs during peak seasons, working capital        未來擴展計劃所需營運資金及預計之外的需求。本
   for future expansion plans and unexpected needs. The Group has        集團於償還貸款方面並無任何困難。
   not experienced any difficulties in repaying its borrowings.


• The Group’s income and expenditure were mostly denominated            • 本集團之收入及開支主要以港元及人民幣計值，而
   in HKD and RMB, while its assets and liabilities were mostly          資產及負債則主要以港元、人民幣及美元計值。由
   denominated in HKD, RMB and USD. No hedging instrument is             於我們中國內地日常業務營運的收支大多以人民幣
   deployed against RMB fluctuation as most of the daily receipts        結算，對我們的業務並無構成重大的貨幣風險，因
   and payments for our Mainland operations are both made in             而未有針對人民幣波動動用任何對沖工具。
   RMB, which do not pose a substantive currency exposure to
   our business.


• It is our treasury policy to maintain high liquidity in response to   • 我們的庫務政策旨在保持較高的流動資金，以應付
   the requirement of operating cash flows; and to upkeep financial      營運現金流量的需求；同時緊守審慎的財務政策，
   prudence by not engaging in highly leveraged or speculative           避免涉及高槓桿或投機性衍生產品。
   derivative products.

     Effect of RMB fluctuation                                                人民幣波動的影響
     • As part of our business operation is in Mainland China, the            • 由於我們有部份業務在中國內地經營，人民幣的波
        fluctuation in RMB would post some impact on our performance.          動對我們的表現構成若干影響。


     • Transactions entered by the Hong Kong entities but                     • 香港公司以人民幣計值的交易（包括與中國內地附
        denominated in RMB, including the inter-group transactions             屬公司進行的集團間交易）會按交易當天的現貨匯
        with the Mainland China subsidiaries, are converted into HKD,          率兌換為港元，即本集團的功能貨幣，而未結算的
        the functional currency of the Group, initially using the spot rate    交易則會以收市匯率於結算日重新換算。現貨匯率
        at the date of transaction and the unsettled transactions are          與收市匯率的換算差異於損益賬中確認，而人民幣
        retranslated at closing exchange rate at the balance sheet date.       貶值會對我們的年內溢利構成負面影響。
        Such translation differences between the spot rate and closing
        exchange rate are recognised in profit or loss, negatively
        affecting our profit for the year when RMB depreciated.


     • Exchange difference also arises when i) incomes and expenses           • 此外，匯兌差異源於 i）中國內地分部的收支按平均
        of the Mainland China segment are translated into HKD, the             匯率換算為港元，即本集團呈列貨幣，而相應的資
        presentation currency of the Group, at the average exchange            產及負債按收市匯率換算；及 ii）中國內地分部的資
        rate, while the corresponding assets and liabilities are translated    產淨值於本財政年度的收市匯率較上個財政年度的
        at closing exchange rate and ii) change in closing exchange            收市匯率有所變動。有關差異於權益中的換算儲備
        rates at the current financial year of the net assets of the           內確認入賬。
        Mainland China segment from the closing rates at the previous
        financial year. Such differences are recognised in the translation
        reserve in equity.

   – its business development plans and capital requirements etc.        — 其業務發展計劃和資本需求等
• Usually declares dividends twice a year, in the absence of           • 在沒有特殊情況下，本公司每年擬宣派兩次股息。
   special circumstances.

      Risk culture & risk strategy                                                風險文化與風險策略
      Our risk culture and risk strategy provide the overall direction and        我們的風險文化和風險策略提供企業風險管理的整體
      objectives of ERM to promote a common understanding and                     方向和目標，促進本集團內部對企業風險管理的共同
      consistent ERM practices within the Group. Our ERM objectives:              理解和貫徹常規。我們的企業風險管理目標如下：


      • Balance business risks and returns and support risk-based                 • 平衡業務風險和回報，支持以風險評估為基礎的決策。
         decision-making.
      • Facilitate the achievements of the Group’s strategic goals                • 通過加強識別未來的機遇和威脅，助本集團達成策
         through better identification of future opportunities and threats.          略性目標。
      • Develop a common understanding of risk across different                   • 不同的業務職能部門之間形成對風險的共同理解，
         business functions to manage risk cost-effectively on an                    以便於企業層面進行符合成本效益的風險管理。
         enterprise-wide basis.
      • Commit to integrity, business ethics, and legal compliance.               • 致力於誠信、商業道德和遵守法規。

   Risk governance model                                                    風險管治模型
   Our risk governance model is designed to assist the Board of             我們的風險管治模型旨在協助董事會和董事委員會持
   Directors and Board Committees to carry out ongoing oversight            續監督和監察我們企業風險管理系統的成效。該模型
   and monitoring on the effectiveness of our ERM system. The               訂立明確的風險角色和架構，以加強本集團與風險事
   model defines clear risk roles and structure to reinforce the risk-      宜相關的問責及透明度。
   related accountability and transparency across the Group.


   We believe a well-coordinated and integrated collection of all the       我們相信，通過良好協調和綜合收集管治、績效保證、
   resources and expertise necessary to support the governance,             風險和合規活動所需的所有資源和專業知識，對本集
   assurance of performance, risk, and compliance activities is critical    團在不斷變化的營商環境和監管環境中實現業務目標
   for the Group to meet its business objectives in the ever-changing       至關重要。為此，我們已建立管治、風險及合規工作
   business environment and regulatory landscape. For this reason,          小組，以協調曾經分散在各風險監察單位的多元化資
   we have established the Governance, Risk, and Compliance                 源。此統一的單位使我們能夠採取綜合方法管理和加
   (“GRC”) Working Group to coordinate the diversified resources            強管治、風險及合規活動。
   that were once scattered within various risk monitoring units. This
   unified unit enables us to adopt an integrated approach to manage
   and enhance GRC activities.

Main features of the risk identification                                    風險識別框架的主要特點
framework

Diversified risk          • To ensure the completeness of our risk inventory, we have established diversified risk identification
identification channels      channels to identify internal, emerging, and changing risks that might affect the achievement of
多樣化的風險識別渠道                   our business objectives and strategies
                             為確保風險清單的完整性，我們建立多樣化的風險識別渠道，以識別可能影響達致業務目標和策略的內
                             部、新興和不斷變化的風險

Portfolio view of risks   • To ensure we are well-positioned to determine whether the residual risk profile aligns with the
風險組合觀                        overall risk appetite, our risk inventory is categorised to facilitate the formation of a portfolio view
                             of risk, allowing us to consider the type, severity, and interdependencies of common risks
                             collectively
                             為確保我們更有效評估剩餘風險狀況是否符合整體的風險承受度，我們將風險清單分類，形成風險組合
                             觀，使我們一併考慮共同的風險類型、嚴重程度和相互關係。

Risk inventory            • The GRC Working Group will perform a periodic review on the risk inventory to ensure the existing
management                   risks are still applicable and relevant and also identify the changes to the existing risks
風險清單管理                       管治、風險及合規工作小組將定期審閱風險清單，以確保現有風險仍然適用和相關，並識別現有風險的
                             變化


                          • Our risk inventory is also informed by the results of internal risk assessments and risk assurance
                             works, as well as insights from various industry sources
                             我們的風險清單亦參考內部風險評估和風險鑒證工作的結果，以及來自各業界人士的見解


                          • To ensure our ERM Framework incorporates the evolving risk landscape appropriately, our risk
                             inventory also addresses hot topics in risk management like ESG-related risks and
                             cybersecurity risks
                             為確保我們的企業風險管理框架適當地融入不斷變化的風險狀況，我們的風險清單亦包含風險管理的
                             熱門話題，例如可持續發展風險和網絡安全風險

Main features of the risk evaluation framework                             風險評估框架的主要特點

Holistic risk assessment   • The severity of risks is assessed at multiple levels by risk owners, GRC Working Group, and GRMC
全面的風險評估                       to ensure comprehensive risk assessment
                              風險承擔者、管治、風險及合規工作小組和集團風險管理委員會從多個層面評估風險的嚴重性，以確保
                              全面的風險評估


                           • Risk owners in operational units are responsible to assess the risks individually at least once a year
                              and the operational assessment result will be escalated to the GRC Working Group for entity level
                              assessment
                              營運單位的風險承擔者負責至少每年個別評估風險一次，並將營運評估結果上報管治、風險及合規工作
                              小組進行企業層面評估


                           • The focus of the entity level assessment is to assess the risk interaction, in which the GRC
                              Working Group will consider those severe risks identified at the operational level and group
                              common risks across operational units and assess the risk level collectively
                              企業層面評估的重點是評估風險的相互關係，其中管治、風險及合規工作小組將考慮該等在營運層面識
                              別的嚴重風險，並將各營運單位的共同風險分組，一併評估共同風險的風險水平


                           • The final assessment result is depicted on the business objective heat map, which will be
                              reviewed by GRMC
                              最終評估結果將呈現於集團關鍵風險熱點圖，並由集團風險管理委員會審視

      2.2 Principles of consolidation and equity                              2.2 合併及權益會計原則
          accounting
      (a)    Subsidiaries                                                     (a)   附屬公司
             Subsidiaries are all entities (including structured                    附屬公司為本集團擁有控制權的所有實體
             entities) over which the Group has control.                            （包括架構性實體）。


             The Group controls an entity when the Group:                           本集團於下列情況下控制一家實體：


             • has power over the entity;                                           • 對實體有控制權；


             • is exposed, or has rights, to variable returns from its              • 對因參與該實體而承受或享有浮動回報
                involvement with the entity; and                                       的風險或權益；及


             • has the ability to affect those returns through its                  • 有能力透過其對該實體的權力影響其回報。
                power to direct the activities of the entity.


             The Group reassesses whether or not it controls an                     倘事實及情況反映上文所列三項控制因素
             entity if facts and circumstances indicate that there are              其中一項或多項改變，則本集團會重估是
             changes to one or more of the three elements of                        否仍然控制實體。
             control listed above.


             When the Group has less than a majority of the voting                  倘本集團於實體之投票權未能佔大多數，
             rights of an entity, it has power over the entity when                 而投票權足以賦予本集團實際能力以單方
             the voting rights are sufficient to give it the practical              面指示實體的相關活動時，即對實體擁有
             ability to direct the relevant activities of the entity                權力。本集團於評估本集團於實體的投票
             unilaterally. The Group considers all relevant facts and               權是否足以賦予其權力時考慮所有相關事
             circumstances in assessing whether or not the Group’s                  實及情況，包括：
             voting rights in an entity are sufficient to give it
             power, including:


             • the size of the Group’s holding of voting rights                     • 與其他投票權持有人所持投票權的數量
                relative to the size and dispersion of holdings of the                 及分散情況相對於本集團持有投票權的
                other vote holders;                                                    數量；


             • potential voting rights held by the Group, other vote                • 本集團、其他投票權持有人或其他人士
                holders or other parties;                                              持有之潛在投票權；


             • rights arising from other contractual arrangements; and              • 其他合約安排產生的權利；及


             • any additional facts and circumstances that indicate                 • 於需要作出決定之時，顯示本集團目前
                that the Group has, or does not have, the current                      能夠或不能指示相關活動的任何額外事
                ability to direct the relevant activities at the time                  實及情況（包括於過往股東會議上的投
                that decisions need to be made, including voting                       票模式）。
                patterns at previous shareholders’ meetings.


             Subsidiaries are fully consolidated from the date on                   附屬公司在控制權轉移至本集團當日開始
             which control is transferred to the Group. They are                    全面合併入賬。附屬公司在控制權終止日
             deconsolidated from the date that control ceases.                      起從合併賬內剔除。

             (c)   Equity method                                                     (c)   權益法
                   Under the equity method of accounting, the                              根據權益會計法，投資初始以成本確認，

                   adjusted thereafter to recognise the Group’s share of                   司在收購後的損益份額，本集團應佔被投
                   the post-acquisition profits or losses of the investee in               資公司之其他全面收益變動則於其他全面

                   comprehensive income. Dividends received or

                   When the Group’s share of losses in an equity-                          當本集團分佔於權益列賬投資的虧損相等
                   accounted investment equals or exceeds its interest in                  於或超過在該實體的權益（包括任何其他

              Revenue is measured at the fair value of the                    營業額按本集團一般業務過程中出售商

              course of the Group’s business.


              Revenue is recognised when control over a product               營業額於產品或服務的控制權轉移或提
              or service is transferred or provided to the customer,          供給客戶時確認，金額為本集團預期將
              at the amount of promised consideration to which the            有權收取之承諾代價，但不包括代表第
              Group is expected to be entitled, excluding those               三方收取的有關金額。營業額不包括增
              amounts collected on behalf of third parties. Revenue           值稅或其他銷售稅，且乃經扣減任何貿
              excludes value added tax or other sales taxes and is            易折扣。
              after deduction of any trade discounts.

8.    INTEREST INCOME AND FINANCE                                        8.   利息收入及融資成本
      COSTS

        Accounting Policy                                                     會計政策
        Interest income                                                       利息收入
        Interest income from financial assets at FVPL is included in          來自按公允值計入損益的金融資產的利息收入
        the net fair value gains and losses on these assets.                  計入該等資產的公允值收益及虧損淨額中。


        Interest income on financial assets at amortised cost                 按攤銷成本計量的金融資產的利息收入使用實
        calculated using the effective interest method is recognised          際利率法計算，於損益確認為其他收入。
        in the profit or loss as part of other income.


        Interest income is presented as finance income where it is            持作現金管理用途的金融資產賺取利息收入
        earned from financial assets that are held for cash                   時，利息收入會呈列為融資收入。任何其他利
        management purposes. Any other interest income is                     息收入則計入其他收入。
        included in other income.


        Interest income is calculated by applying the effective               利息收入將實際利率應用至金融資產賬面總值
        interest rate to the gross carrying amount of a financial             計算得出，惟其後出現信貸虧損的金融資產除
        asset except for financial assets that subsequently become            外。就信貸減值金融資產，實際利率應用於金
        credit-impaired. For credit-impaired financial assets the             融資產淨賬面值（扣除虧損撥備後）。
        effective interest rate is applied to the net carrying
        amount of the financial assets (after deduction of the
        loss allowance).


        Borrowing costs                                                       借貸成本
        General and specific borrowing costs that are directly                直接源自收購、建築或生產合資格資產的一般
        attributable to the acquisition, construction or production of        及特定借貸成本於完成及籌備資產以作其擬定
        a qualifying asset are capitalised during the period of time          用途或銷售所需期間內資本化。合資格資產指
        that is required to complete and prepare the asset for its            需要大量時間籌備以作擬定用途或銷售的資產。
        intended use or sale. Qualifying assets are assets that
        necessarily take a substantial period of time to get ready for
        their intended use or sale.


        Investment income earned on the temporary investment of               在特定借款撥作合資格資產支出前之暫時投資
        specific borrowings pending their expenditure on qualifying           所賺取之投資收入，須從合資格資本化之借款
        assets is deducted from the borrowing costs eligible                  成本中扣除。
        for capitalisation.


        Other borrowing costs are expensed in the period in which             其他借貸成本於其產生之期間內支銷。
        they are incurred.

11. TAXATION                                                                                      11. 稅項

          Accounting Policy                                                                         會計政策
          The income tax expense or credit for the period is the tax                                本期之所得稅支出或抵免是本期應課稅收入按
          payable on the current period’s taxable income based on                                   徵稅地區適用之稅率計算的應付稅項，並會因
          the applicable income tax rate for each jurisdiction adjusted                             應暫時性差額和未動用之稅項虧損導致的遞延

        Changing the assumptions selected by management in
        assessing impairment, including the discount rates or the
        growth rate assumptions in the cash flow projections, could
        materially affect the net present value used in the

        significant adverse change in the projected performance
        and resulting future cash flow projections, it may be
        necessary to take an impairment charge to the consolidated
        income statement.

        Accounting Policy                                                    會計政策
        Leases are recognised as a right-of-use asset and a                  租賃於租賃資產可供本集團使用當日會確認為
        corresponding liability at the date at which the leased asset        使用權資產及相關負債。
        is available for use by the Group.


        Contracts may contain both lease and non-lease                       合約可能包含租賃及非租賃成份。本集團按照租
        components. The Group allocates the consideration in the             賃及非租賃成份相應的獨立價格，將合約代價分
        contract to the lease and non-lease components based on              配至租賃及非租賃成份。然而，對本集團為承租
        their relative stand-alone prices. However, for leases of real       人的房地產租賃而言，其選擇將租賃及非租賃成
        estate for which the Group is a lessee, it has elected not to        份視為單一租賃成份，並無將兩者區分。
        separate lease and non-lease components and instead
        accounts for these as a single lease component.


        Assets and liabilities arising from a lease are initially            租賃產生的資產及負債初始按現值計量。租賃
        measured on a present value basis. Lease liabilities include         負債包括下列租賃付款的淨現值：
        the net present value of the following lease payments:


        •     fixed payments (including in-substance fixed payments),        •   固定付款（包括實質固定付款）扣減任何
              less any lease incentives receivable;                              應收租賃優惠；


        •     variable lease payment that are based on an index or           •   取決於指數或比率的浮動租賃付款（初始
              a rate, initially measured using the index or rate as at           於開始日期利用指數或比率計量）；
              the commencement date;


        •     amounts expected to be payable by the Group under              •   本集團根據餘值擔保預期應付的金額；
              residual value guarantees;


        •     the exercise price of a purchase option if the Group is        •   在本集團合理確定行使採購選擇權的情
              reasonably certain to exercise that option; and                    況下採購選擇權的行使價；及


        •     payments of penalties for terminating the lease, if the        •   在租期反映本集團行使該選擇權的情況
              lease term reflects the Group exercising that option.              下，終止租賃的罰款。


              Lease payments to be made under reasonably certain                 根據合理確定延續選擇權支付的租賃付
              extension options are also included in the                         款亦計入負債計量之內。
              measurement of the liability.


              The lease payments are discounted using the interest               租賃付款採用租賃所隱含的利率予以貼
              rate implicit in the lease. If that rate cannot be readily         現。倘無法釐定該利率（本集團的租賃一
              determined, which is generally the case for leases in              般屬此類情況），則使用承租人遞增借貸
              the Group, the lessee’s incremental borrowing rate is              利率，即個別承租人在類似經濟環境中
              used, being the rate that the individual lessee would              按類似條款、抵押及條件借入獲得與使
              have to pay to borrow the funds necessary to obtain                用權資產價值類似的資產所需資金必須
              an asset of similar value to the right-of-use asset in a           支付的利率。
              similar economic environment with similar terms,
              security and conditions.

               Investment properties are initially measured at cost,            投資物業初步按成本（包括相關交易成本及借
               including related transaction costs and where applicable         貸 成 本（如 適用））計 量。初 始 確認 後，投 資物
               borrowing costs. Subsequent to initial recognition,              業按成本減其後累計折舊及任何累計減值虧損
               investment properties are stated at cost less subsequent         列賬。
               accumulated depreciation and any accumulated
               impairment losses.


               If there is a transfer from investment property to owner-        倘將投資物業轉撥至自用物業，以擁有人開始
               occupied property evidenced by the commencement of               佔用為證，則該物業於其後入賬時按變更用途
               owner’s occupation, the property shall be measured at its        日期之賬面值計量。
               carrying amount at the date of change in use for
               subsequent accounting.


               Depreciation is recognised so as to write off the cost of        投資物業按估計可使用年期，經考慮其估計剩
               investment properties over their estimated useful lives and      餘價值後，按直線基準於 20 年或租約年期確認
               after taking into account their estimated residual value,        折舊，以撇銷投資物業成本。
               using the straight-line basis over 20 years or lease term.


               An investment property is derecognised upon disposal or          投資物業於出售後或投資物業永久不再使用且
               when the investment property is permanently withdrawn            預期出售不會產生未來經濟利益時終止確認。

               from the disposal. Any gain or loss arising on derecognition     產之出售所得款項淨額與賬面值之差額計算）
               of the property (calculated as the difference between the        於該物業終止確認期間計入損益。

      17. GOODWILL                                                               17. 商譽

               Accounting Policy                                                   會計政策
               Goodwill is measured as described in note 39. Goodwill is           商譽按附註 39 所述計量。商譽不會攤銷，惟會
               not amortised but it is tested for impairment annually, or          每年進行減值測試，如發生事件或情況有變，
               more frequently if events or changes in circumstances               顯 示 商 譽 可 能 減 值， 則 會 更 頻 密 進 行 減 值 測
               indicate that it might be impaired, and is carried at cost less     試，並且按成本減累計減值虧損列賬。出售實
               accumulated impairment losses. Gains and losses on the              體的損益包括與已售實體有關商譽的賬面值。
               disposal of an entity include the carrying amount of goodwill
               relating to the entity sold.


               Goodwill is allocated to cash-generating units for the              為進行減值測試，商譽已被分配至現金產生單
               purpose of impairment testing. The allocation is made to            位，並分配往預計可於業務合併得益而產生該
               those cash-generating units or groups of cash-generating            商譽之現金產生單位或現金產生單位組別。而
               units that are expected to benefit from the business                現金產生單位或現金產生單位組別乃就內部管
               combination in which the goodwill arose. The                        理目的於監察商譽的最低層級（即經營分部）確
               units or groups of units are identified at the lowest level         認（附註 4）。
               at which goodwill is monitored for internal management
               purposes, being the operating segments (note 4).


               Critical Accounting Estimates                                       主要會計估算
               The Group tests whether goodwill has suffered any                   本集團會每年測試商譽是否出現任何減值。截
               impairment on an annual basis. For the year ended 31                至 2021 年及 2020 年 3 月 31 日止年度，現金產
               March 2021 and 2020, the recoverable amount of cash-                生單位的可收回金額乃根據需要使用假設的使
               generating units (CGUs) was determined based on value-in-           用價值計算釐定。該計算使用基於董事批准的
               use calculations which require the use of assumptions.              五年期財務預算的現金流量預測。
               The calculations use cash flow projections based on

22. DEFERRED TAXATION                                                       22. 遞延稅項

        Accounting Policy                                                     會計政策
        Deferred income tax is provided in full, using the liability          遞延所得稅採用負債法就資產負債之稅基與它
        method, on temporary differences arising between the tax              們在綜合財務報表之賬面值兩者之短暫時差作
        bases of assets and liabilities and their carrying amounts in         全數撥備。然而如遞延稅項負債因初始確認為
        the consolidated financial statements. However, deferred              商譽而產生，則不予以確認。若遞延稅項來自
        tax liabilities are not recognised if they arise from the initial     交易（不包括業務合併）中對資產或負債的初步
        recognition of goodwill. Deferred income tax is also not              確認，而在交易時不影響會計損益或應課稅盈
        accounted for if it arises from initial recognition of an asset       虧，亦不作記賬。遞延稅項採用在報告期末前
        or liability in a transaction other than a business combination       已頒佈或實際頒佈之稅率（或法例）釐定，並預
        that at the time of the transaction affects neither accounting        期在有關之遞延稅項資產實現或遞延稅項負債
        nor taxable profit or loss. Deferred income tax is                    結算時應用。
        determined using tax rates (and laws) that have been
        enacted or substantively enacted by the end of the
        reporting period and are expected to apply when the related
        deferred income tax asset is realised or the deferred
        income tax liability is settled.


        Deferred tax assets are recognised only if it is probable that        遞延稅項資產僅在未來應課稅金額將可用於動
        future taxable amounts will be available to utilise those             用該等暫時差額及虧損時予以確認。
        temporary differences and losses.


        Deferred tax liabilities and assets are not recognised for            倘本公司能控制撥回暫時差額的時間及該等差
        temporary differences between the carrying amount and                 異很可能不會於可見將來撥回，則不會就境外
        tax bases of investments in foreign operations where the              業務投資賬面值與稅基之間的暫時差額確認遞
        company is able to control the timing of the reversal of the          延稅項負債及資產。
        temporary differences and it is probable that the differences
        will not reverse in the foreseeable future.


        Deferred tax assets and liabilities are offset where there is         當有可依法強制執行的權利將即期稅項資產與
        a legally enforceable right to offset current tax assets and          負債抵銷，而遞延稅項結餘與同一稅務機構相
        liabilities and where the deferred tax balances relate to the         關時，則可將遞延稅項資產與負債抵銷。當實
        same taxation authority. Current tax assets and tax liabilities       體有可依法強制執行抵銷權利且有意按淨額基
        are offset where the entity has a legally enforceable right to        準結算或同時變現資產及清償負債時，則即期
        offset and intends either to settle on a net basis, or to             稅項資產與稅項負債抵銷。
        realise the asset and settle the liability simultaneously.


        Current and deferred tax is recognised in profit or loss,             即期及遞延稅項將於損益中確認，如與該稅項
        except to the extent that it relates to items recognised in           有關之項目直接於其他全面收益或權益中確
        other comprehensive income or directly in equity. In this             認，則該等相關稅項分別於其他全面收益或直
        case, the tax is also recognised in other comprehensive               接在權益中確認。
        income or directly in equity, respectively.

                 Accounting Policy                                                                            會計政策
                 Borrowings are initially recognised at fair value, net of                                    借款最初乃按公允值（扣除已產生的交易成本）

                 measured at amortised cost. Any difference between the                                       成本之後的所得款項及贖回金額出現差額，則
                 proceeds (net of transaction costs) and the redemption                                       於借款期內以實際利率法於損益內確認。在貸
                 amount is recognised in profit or loss over the period of the                                款很有可能部份或全部提取的情況下，就設立
                 borrowings using the effective interest method. Fees paid                                    貸款融資支付的費用乃確認為貸款交易成本。
                 on the establishment of loan facilities are recognised as                                    在 此 情 況 下， 該 費 用 將 遞 延 至 提 取 貸 款 發 生

                 that some or all of the facility will be drawn down. In this                                 部提取的情況下，該費用撥充資本作為流動資
                 case, the fee is deferred until the draw down occurs. To                                     金服務的預付款項，並於其相關融資期間內予
                 the extent there is no evidence that it is probable that some                                以攤銷。
                 or all of the facility will be drawn down, the fee is
                 capitalised as a prepayment for liquidity services and
                 amortised over the period of the facility to which it relates.

                 consideration paid, including any non-cash assets

                 loss as finance costs.

      33. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                               33. 資本風險管理
             The Group manages its capital to ensure that the group               本集團管理資本旨在確保集團實體可持續經營，
             entities will be able to continue as a going concern while           並透過維持債務與權益的最佳平衡而為股東提供
             maximising the return to shareholders through the                    最大回報。
             optimisation of the debt and equity balance.


             The capital structure of the Group consists of bank                  本集團的資本架構包括銀行貸款、黃金借貸和本
             borrowings, gold loans and equity attributable to                    公司股東應佔股權（包括綜合財務報表所披露之
             shareholders of the Company, comprising share capital,               股本、儲備及保留溢利）。
             reserves and retained profits as disclosed in the consolidated
             financial statements.


             The management of the Group reviews the capital structure            本集團管理層定期檢討資本架構。本集團會考慮
             regularly. The Group considers the cost of capital and the           資本成本及各類資本相關的風險，亦透過派付股
             risks associated with each class of capital, and will balance        息、發行新股、籌集銀行貸款及黃金借貸平衡本
             its overall capital structure through the payment of dividends,      集團整體資本架構。
             new share issues as well as the raising of bank borrowings
             and gold loans.

               Post-employment obligations                                          僱員離職後責任
               The Group operates various post-employment schemes,                  本集團營運多個僱員離職後計劃，包括定額福
               including both defined benefit and defined contribution              利及定額供款退休計劃。
               pension plans.

               The liability or asset recognised in the consolidated                於綜合財務狀況表就定額福利退休金計劃確認
               statement of financial position in respect of defined benefit        的負債或資產乃定額福利責任於報告期結算日
               pension plans is the present value of the defined benefit            的現值減計劃資產的公允值。定額福利責任每
               obligation at the end of the reporting period less the fair          年由獨立精算師利用預測單位貸記法計算。
               value of plan assets. The defined benefit obligation is
               calculated annually by independent actuaries using the
               projected unit credit method.

               The present value of the defined benefit obligation is               定額福利責任的現值利用以支付福利的貨幣計
               determined by discounting the estimated future cash                  值、到期情況與相關責任年期相若的優質公司
               outflows using interest rates of high-quality corporate              債 券 的 利 率， 將 估 計 未 來 現 金 流 出 貼 現 而 釐
               bonds that are denominated in the currency in which the              定。就債券並無深入市場的國家而言，則利用
               benefits will be paid, and that have terms approximating to          政府債券的市場利率。
               the terms of the related obligation. In countries where there
               is no deep market in such bonds, the market rates on
               government bonds are used.

               Service cost and net interest cost on the net defined                定額福利負債淨額的服務成本及利息成本淨額
               benefit liability are recognised in profit or loss and allocated     於損益內確認，且按功能分配入「銷售及分銷
               by function as part of “selling and distribution costs” or           成本」或「一般及行政開支」之一部份。即期服
               “general and administrative expenses”. Current service               務成本按僱員於本期提供服務產生定額福利責
               cost is measured as the increase in the present value of the         任之現值增幅計算。利息成本淨額透過將貼現
               defined benefit obligation resulting from employee service           率應用於定額福利責任結餘淨額及計劃資產公
               in the current period. The net interest cost is calculated by        允值計算。
               applying the discount rate to the net balance of the defined
               benefit obligation and the fair value of plan assets.

               Remeasurement gains and losses arising from experience               經驗調整及精算假設變動產生的損益重新計量
               adjustments and changes in actuarial assumptions are                 於產生期間直接於其他全面收益內確認。有關
               recognised in the period in which they occur, directly in            損益計入綜合權益變動表及綜合財務狀況表的
               other comprehensive income. They are included in retained            保留盈利。

39. BUSINESS COMBINATION                                                   39. 業務合併

        Accounting Policy                                                    會計政策
        The acquisition method of accounting is used to account for          所有業務合併均以收購會計法入賬，無論所收
        all business combinations, regardless of whether equity              購者為權益工具或其他資產。收購一間附屬公
        instruments or other assets are acquired. The consideration          司所轉讓的代價包括：
        transferred for the acquisition of a subsidiary comprises the:

        •     fair values of the assets transferred                          •   所轉讓資產的公允值

        •     liabilities incurred to the former owners of the               •   所收購業務先前擁有人產生的負債
              acquired business

        •     equity interests issued by the Group                           •   本集團發行的股權

        •     fair value of any asset or liability resulting from a          •   或然代價安排產生的任何資產或負債的
              contingent consideration arrangement; and                          公允值；及

        •     fair value of any pre-existing equity interest in the          •   任何先前存在的附屬公司股權的公允值。
              subsidiary.

        Identifiable assets acquired and liabilities and contingent          除有限例外情況外，於業務合併收購的可識別
        liabilities assumed in a business combination are, with              資產以及承擔的負債及或然負債初步按收購日
        limited exceptions, measured initially at their fair values at       期的公允值計量。本集團根據個別收購交易按
        the acquisition date. The Group recognises any non-                  公允值或非控股權益應佔被收購實體可識別資
        controlling interest in the acquired entity on an acquisition-       產淨值的比例確認於被收購實體的任何非控股
        by-acquisition basis either at fair value or at the non-             權益。
        controlling interest’s proportionate share of the acquired
        entity’s net identifiable assets.

        Acquisition-related costs are expensed as incurred.                  收購相關成本於產生時支銷。

        The excess of the:

        •     consideration transferred;                                     •   所轉讓代價；

        •     amount of any non-controlling interest in the acquired         •   於被收購實體的任何非控股權益金
              entity; and                                                        額；及

        •     acquisition-date fair value of any previous equity             •   任何先前於被收購實體的權益於收購日
              interest in the acquired entity                                    期的公允值

        over the fair value of the net identifiable assets acquired is       高於已收購可識別資產淨值的公允值的差額按
        recorded as goodwill. If those amounts are less than the             商譽列賬。倘上述金額低於所收購業務可識別
        fair value of the net identifiable assets of the business            資產淨值的公允值，有關差額會作為一項收購
        acquired, the difference is recognised directly in profit or         附屬公司收益直接於損益確認。
        loss as a gain on acquisition of subsidiaries.

        Where settlement of any part of cash consideration is                倘任何部份現金代價的結算獲遞延，日後應付
        deferred, the amounts payable in the future are discounted           金額貼現至彼等於兌換日期的現值。所用的貼
        to their present value as at the date of exchange. The               現率乃該實體的遞增借貸利率，即從獨立融資
        discount rate used is the entity’s incremental borrowing             者根據相若的條款及細則獲得同類借貸的利
        rate, being the rate at which a similar borrowing could be           率。或然代價分為權益或金融負債。分類為金
        obtained from an independent financier under comparable              融負債的金額隨後重新計量其公允值，而公允
        terms and conditions. Contingent consideration is classified         值變動則於損益內確認。
